turns.user_utterance: Can I used my card even if my phone has been stolen?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry to hear that. If your phone is stolen, you may still be able to use the physical card, but you should secure your account first by reporting the stolen phone—especially to stop any in-app verification or card controls. Can you confirm: is your card also lost/stolen, or only the phone?

turns.user_utterance: Only my phone was taken, the card is still with me.
turns.assistant_response: Yes—if only your phone was stolen and you still have your card, you can generally continue using the card. However, you should immediately report the stolen phone in the app (or contact us) so we can secure your account and stop any access or verification tied to the phone. Do you currently still have access to your app/account to report the phone?
